scope: Production loopback HTTP, shared in-memory Flash transactions, installed-byte native catalog pagination, role resolve/command, native C++ semantic dispatch, ordered rollback, and six delivery documents.
resolved_findings: Reconnect uses a unique enable command ID, a monotonic clock and an actual native endpoint disconnect.
Accepted work is cancelled at the native endpoint before the owner runs; old receipts and context are rejected after reconnect.
Resource reboot and App changes invalidate old bridge commands and directories, with boot identity bound to the simulated generation.
Both 1083-file frozen source manifests are fully checked using the existing precise dependencies.lock local-path normalization.
The validator inventory includes the actual authoring catalog, target metadata, partitions, installed reference manifest and workbench pages.
A missing catalog page reaches the production request timeout and cannot produce a role command.

earlier_behavior_run.interpretation: Behavior passed while source was changing; not used as final frozen verification. A later stable rerun and the frozen report were independently checked.

independent_checks.publication_and_git_checks: Recorded by the parent in result.json; not independently rerun during this read-only peer review.

verification_boundaries.flash_and_bottom_io: Memory simulation; no device or serial access.
verification_boundaries.firmware_execution: Host-compiled production C++ selected by installed App bytes; not an emulator of the retained firmware binary.
verification_boundaries.directory_hashing: Production catalog builder and mounted adapter with real vendored cJSON and SHA-256.
verification_boundaries.expression_fingerprinting: Existing deterministic host-only fingerprint shim; retained firmware uses mbedTLS.
verification_boundaries.display: SetEmotion stub verifies semantic scheduling and dispatch counts.
verification_boundaries.physical_baseline: E3d-2b / E1.18 retained; not probed in this review.
